item.title: Version 0.3.8
item.description:
Live LUT 0.3.8

Live LUT 0.3.8

- New ALL group in the Setup toolbar: one LUT | LOG switch for all cameras (⌥⌘L).

- Set one conversion LUT on every camera from the toolbar.

- Legal | Full range for all cameras in the same dropdown.

item.title: Version 0.3.7
item.description:
Live LUT 0.3.7

Settings › Cameras is one table: for each camera set its name (tile and Zoom), which input it shows, and which camera it controls (IP or hostname). Picking an input another camera uses swaps the two.

Match pictures to cameras: one click puts colour bars on each camera in turn and puts every picture on the tile that controls it (Setup mode, Movie Recorder closed).

Program: switching cameras no longer flashes the setup checklist in the window.

item.title: Version 0.3.6
item.description:
Live LUT 0.3.6

Scopes are sharp and live: drawn on the GPU at full frame rate and Retina resolution.

False color key: while false color is on, a key under the toolbar shows what each colour means and its range.

Right-click a picture for a ring of quick actions: Focus here, Magnify 2× here, False color, Focus peaking, Scopes, Show only this camera.

Picture bar is grouped: LUT|LOG · exposure · focus · frame · solo.

Program: "Tools on TVs" is now a labelled switch (on the picture and in the TVs section). Frame guides, including 9:16, now show on the TVs too. Zoom stays clean.

Camera panel tidied: Manual/Auto sits in the camera header; Reset all sits next to the range.

Swap picture and control moved to Settings › Cameras › Swap.

Stream Deck / Companion: the Program control API is complete and documented.

item.title: Version 0.3.5
item.description:
Live LUT 0.3.5

Fixed: turning on focus peaking, zebras or false color no longer changes the picture's brightness.

False color now uses the standard camera scale (Blackmagic / ARRI): purple crushed, blue near black, green 18% grey, pink skin, yellow near clipping, red clipped. "Simple" is still an option in Overlays.

Scopes and frame guides open the same compact panel; aspect ratio is a small dropdown.

Save Diagnostics now asks each camera what it can be controlled for (tally, power), so we can check it.

If two cameras show on the wrong tiles, right-click a picture and choose Swap with… to move the picture and the camera control together.

Exposure match: pin a camera as the reference; it stays the reference while you select other cameras.

Top toolbar: false color, focus peaking and zebras on all cameras with one click (⌥⌘F / ⌥⌘P / ⌥⌘Z).

item.title: Version 0.3.4
item.description:
Live LUT 0.3.4

Program screen: the TV button (and "Also on the SDI output" under Picture tools) puts false color, focus peaking and zebras on the TVs too, like a field monitor. Zoom never gets them, a red TOOLS ON SDI OUT tag shows while it is on, and it is off again every time Live LUT starts.

Tint: double-click (or Reset all) now sets tint to neutral 0 on every camera.

Mode: Auto | Setup | Program. Auto follows Movie Recorder and shows which mode it's in.

Scopes on each picture (waveform, RGB parade, vectorscope, histogram) from the picture's bar.

Frame guides from the picture's bar: aspect ratios (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 1.85, 2.35, 2.39), centre cross, thirds, safe areas.

False color "Simple": good exposure stays grey, yellow = too bright, red = clipped, blue/purple = too dark ("Zones" still available).

Exposure match: all four cameras side by side with how many stops each is off, Match / Match all buttons, and Link to adjust all cameras together (not focus).

item.title: Version 0.3.3
item.description:
Live LUT 0.3.3

Fixed: the program SDI output could never open ("No DeckLink output"), and Settings › Studio › Program output listed no connectors. Every DeckLink connector that can play out is now listed.

item.title: Version 0.3.2
item.description:
Live LUT 0.3.2

Magnify 2× / 4× on every camera and the program picture (button on the picture's bar; drag to move around).

Scopes under the camera controls: waveform, RGB parade and histogram, with clipped and crushed percentages.

Picture tools with full names: false color, focus peaking, zebras.

Tint now reads 0 at neutral, minus toward green and plus toward magenta, with a Neutral (0) button.

"Auto Switch" replaces "Follow Movie Recorder".

item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description:
Live LUT 0.3.1

Fixed: changing the shutter could nearly close it (unit mix-up), making the picture very dark.

Iris now works in real f-stops: the number updates instantly and is checked against the camera.

Double-click any camera value to put it back to where it was when Live LUT connected; Reset all does them all.

Click the big value to type a number (e.g. 5600 for white balance).

Click-to-focus: press the target icon on the picture's bar, then click where to focus.

Copy to other cameras now shows a tick or a warning per camera.

"Follow Movie Recorder" is now a labelled switch.

Program "no signal" shows a checklist of what to check.

Settings › Studio: every hub port, camera input, recording output and TV can be changed.

Settings › Cameras: Identify (colour bars for 3 s) and Swap, for when a camera's picture and control are crossed.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
Live LUT 0.3.0

New look: dark, minimal, bigger pictures.

Setup layouts: 2×2, one big + three, single camera, side by side (toolbar or ⌥⌘1–4). Click a picture to select it, double-click to show it alone.

Camera control for the four Blackmagic cameras: iris, ISO, shutter, white balance, tint, focus and AF, copy settings to other cameras. Set the camera addresses in Settings › Cameras (macOS asks for Local Network access the first time).

False color, zebras and focus peaking per camera, in Live LUT's window only (never on the TVs or Zoom).

New Program screen with big switcher keys, and a restyled menu bar.

Camera power is not active yet: it needs a network power strip.
